summary: VivoPower PLC filed a Form 6-K on August 21, 2026, providing an update on its issued and outstanding securities. The company reports 31,993,555 Class A Ordinary Shares outstanding with no treasury shares, along with 800,000 Preference Shares convertible into 11,078,431 Class A Ordinary Shares and 1,244,000 in-the-money warrants. This is a routine disclosure of capitalization details, not a special-situation event. No transaction, corporate action, or strategic initiative is announced. The filing merely updates share counts and outstanding instruments, with no deal terms, board actions, or advisors mentioned.
